$comment: Placeable props from CC0 packs. tools/content/prepare-props.mjs normalises each model (centred, standing on y = 0, scaled to `height` metres), embeds its texture, writes packages/client/public/props, content/props.lock.json and packages/shared/src/content/props.generated.ts (sizes and collision for the simulation). collide: box = the model's bounds, trunk = a 0.5 m post, none = walk through.
